product_name: zoned terrain-corrected Bouguer anomaly (planar Nagy; not Complete Bouguer)
kernel: Nagy 1966 rectangular prisms, planar near/intermediate/far annuli on a bound DEM

cases.name: annulus_equals_disk_difference
cases.oracle: Additivity of disjoint planar Nagy annuli (same DEM, same density)

cases.name: flat_plateau_intermediate_zero
cases.oracle: Zero mass difference on a constant-height DEM

cases.name: intermediate_applied_covering_dem
cases.oracle: Coverage ≥ 0.95 inside R_near–R_int on a bound plateau DEM

cases.name: intermediate_skipped_near_only_dem
cases.reason: Bound DEM does not extend beyond the near-zone radius 300.0 m. Intermediate-zone terrain was not invented.
cases.oracle: Bound DEM does not extend beyond the near-zone radius

cases.name: far_skipped_without_covering_dem
cases.reason: Bound DEM half-span 551.5 m does not cover farRadiusM 200000.0 m. Far-zone terrain was not invented. G-AID does not download a global DEM.
cases.oracle: No DEM download; incomplete far ring is a skip, not a silent pass

cases.name: far_skipped_without_radius
cases.reason: farRadiusM is required. G-AID will not assume a global terrain radius or download ETOPO/SRTM.
cases.oracle: farRadiusM is required; no global default

cases.name: far_applied_covering_coarse_dem
cases.oracle: Planar Nagy annulus beyond 166.7 km on a bound DEM that actually covers 180 km
